$comment: Reviewed decisions that complete the mapping file of JA Boxing j6 1.0.11 (ticket #584). Read by packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/ai-quickstart/mapping.mjs with block-store.json, page-recipes.json, draft-report.json and the contract's content-map.json. A place is a content map key (or <key>@<xpath>, a piece of a stored HTML value); every other location names an entity declared under entities. Each statement about the running template was checked on the restored 1.0.11 quickstart.

settings.why: Joomla's global configuration: the installer writes it from what the installation is given (site name, mail sender name), so the blank site carries no value of its own

templateGlobal-ja_boxing.why: the T4 global settings of the template: T4 reads local/etc/global.json instead of etc/global.json when it exists, without merging, so the production step writes the whole file

notFacts.why: the JA Google Map module 164 (position map, coordinates of Wall St) is printed only when the Site setting other_contact_map_modal is on, and it is off (etc/site/default.json); the open in google maps link is built from the contact address, a place of the address fact. Checked on the running 1.0.11 site: no page draws a map
no page shows opening hours: the times the template shows are class schedules (offering.schedule fields)

no place holds the year alone: the demo writes it inside the hero headline (NO1 BOXING STUDIO since 2008, module-156.2), which the block store declares as one text field (block-156.heading, claim.heading); a build writes the founded year in the headline's words only when the business has one
no place holds one address for the business: each button of the template carries its own link field in the block store (13 link fields), which the build fills per button
MOD_FOOTER_LINE1 prints the year and the site name, a place of the name fact; it carries no other business word

the footer logo image (module 170) also carries data-path, the media manager's hint to the demo file local-images:/joomlart/logo/item-1.png; no page draws it and the content map has no place for it. The blank site empties the drawn src (a place of logoDark), so no demo logo shows; the hint stays as the demo has it. Checked on the blank site restored on a real Joomla

AcyMailing's bounce_email, cron_sendto, from_email and the forward_to of its bounce rules hold one placeholder mail address: the technical sending mailbox (the address mail is sent from and bounces go to). Its sender name (from_name) and its reply-to name and address (replyto_name, replyto_email) are the sender identity of that mailbox. The site owner sets them together when they set up sending, in AcyMailing's configuration, which the Claude Cowork door does not write, and no page shows any of them. So none is a business fact the build writes: the blank site empties the sender identity (emptiedNotWritten), so no demo name or address reaches a subscriber, and keeps the mailbox address, which setting up sending replaces

emptiedNotWritten.why: the newsletter's sender name: part of the sender identity the site owner sets with the sending mailbox (notFacts, newsletter mail settings); the blank site empties the demo name
the newsletter's reply-to name: part of the sender identity the site owner sets with the sending mailbox; the blank site empties the demo name
the newsletter's reply-to address: part of the sender identity the site owner sets with the sending mailbox; the blank site empties the demo address

seo.limitsWhy: Search result display limits, not template measurements: a search result shows about 60 characters of a title and about 160 of a description. JA Boxing prints the browser title on no page (the page heading is its own field), so no tighter measured limit applies. The share title (ogTitle) is the SEO title, so the title limit applies to it too.

featuredView.why: Checked on the running 1.0.11 site with Open Graph on: these page types are the featured view of the articles (their demo menu items open view=featured; the home layout draws no component output on home, about, trainers and trainer). T4 prints Open Graph for an article view only from its content events, and the featured view fires them once per featured article it lists: with none published, the page prints its title and meta description but no og:title, og:description or og:image (measured on the home page with every featured article unpublished). With one published, the page prints og:title, og:description and og:image from its own menu item's og_title, og_desc and og_img, which win over the article's own (measured with both set). So the build keeps at least one published featured article on a site that has a page of these types: a post it creates, marked featured. Without any post, these pages print no share title, description or image; no template or plugin change is made for it.

author.derived: the author page is the template's author view of a person: the browser title is the person's name and role, the description their biography, and the share image the picture of the first post listed (T4 Open Graph); all three follow fields of the author-profile block

shareImage.derived: the picture of the first post the page lists

ogTitle.derived: the person's name and role, the author page's title

seo.why: Checked on the running 1.0.11 site with the T4 Open Graph setting on: a page made from a menu item prints page_title as its title, menu-meta_description as its description and og_img as og:image; an article prints article_page_title, metadesc and its own og_img (else the og_img of the menu item it is reached through). JA Boxing ships Open Graph off; the override system_opengraph turns it on. With Open Graph on, T4 prints og:title and the meta title (name="title") from og_title: a menu item's params, an article's attribs (checked: a value set there is printed). Left empty, it falls back to the browser title on a category or featured page, to the article title on an article, and to the contact's name on the contact page; the build writes each page's SEO title (the browser title, which carries the business name) into ogTitle too (sameAs: title), so the share title is never the short heading of the page and no fallback is drawn. An article's og:description is its own attribs og_desc first (checked: a value set there is printed, and wins over the og_desc of the menu item the article is reached through), else its metadesc, else its intro text: the build writes the description at both places of an article, as it does at menu-meta_description and og_desc of a menu item.

library.why: Measured on the running 1.0.11 site by publishing a probe block in section-6, main-bottom-1 and section-5 on every page: section-6 renders on the home layout (home, about, trainers, trainer, plans) and on the default layout (news, featured posts, authors, classes, contact, learning center), last before the footer, in the t4section chrome; an article page (detail-article layout: a post, a class, a learning post, an author page) has no section-6 and renders main-bottom-1 instead. section-5 renders on the home layout only and without a container. Container class: each of these positions wraps its modules in t4-section-inner container, and the template's own modules there add section-inner > container inside it; a probe block measured at 390, 768 and 1440 px starts and ends where the template module's heading does whether its content sits in a container div or not (16/358, 40/688, 16/1408 px), so the library block keeps the template's own class, container.

networkIconClasses.why: Checked on the running 1.0.11 site, every page of which loads Font Awesome Free 5.15.4 (all.min.css) and then Font Awesome 4.7 (font-awesome.min.css): each class was drawn in Chromium and its glyph compared with the font's missing glyph box. The Font Awesome 5 brand classes (fab fa-<name>) draw every network listed; the demo's other pattern, fa fa-<name> (footer and trainer intro), falls to the Font Awesome 4.7 font, which lacks tiktok. Neither font has a Threads glyph (fa-threads) or the X mark (fa-x-twitter), so threads is left out, and x takes the Twitter bird, the only mark the shipped fonts have for that network.
